arms.transform: Minimum of 150 m and 400 m signed polarity: gravity and RTP gradients point the same way, depth-to-basement gradient points the opposite way, times structure-tensor coherence, oblique-to-survey-axis weight, gradient-magnitude ranks, and a soft topographic-density veto.
arms.non_fault_mimic: Unfaulted basin-fill facies contact or volcanic flow edge with the same density/magnetization polarity, plus residual E-W flight-line or N-S tie-line corrugation.
arms.uncatalogued_rationale: Qfaults/INGENIOUS records surface scarps. A basement step under basin fill can offset density and magnetization without a Holocene scarp, so it is absent from the mapped catalogue. Emission never places positive mass on mapped catalogue pixels.
arms.novelty: Unlike H86-WVB unsigned cos(2*delta) alignment, H86E-MMT lag correlation, H86E-SPBT/SPT Laplace paired-throw, and KSLB fluvial/Blakely filaments, this arm requires signed three-field polarity and rejects anti-parallel magnetic-gravity edges.
arms.official_data: Pinned training_features.tif only. Flight-line azimuths from USGS GeoDAWN DOI 10.5066/P93LGLVQ. No new external raster.

arms.transform: E1 multiplied by rank(depth-to-basement) times one minus rank(detrended slope).
arms.non_fault_mimic: Deep unfaulted basin depocenters and low-slope playa interiors.
arms.uncatalogued_rationale: Tests whether the missed-fault signal is specifically the no-scarp, thick-cover subset rather than every basement step.
arms.novelty: Cover weight is a control on E1, not a separate external dataset and not the H86B/H86C cover-blind GBDT head.

arms.transform: Minimum across the same two scales of cos(delta)^2 magnetic-gravity alignment, times coherence and oblique weight, without depth polarity or topographic veto.
arms.non_fault_mimic: Any parallel or anti-parallel magnetic and gravity edge, including intrusive contacts and survey seams that survive the oblique weight.
arms.uncatalogued_rationale: If this control matches or beats E1, the signed-polarity claim is not supported on this holdout.
arms.novelty: This is the ablation of the signed constraint, included so a win cannot be credited to generic edge ranking.

arms.transform: K/Th ridge coincident with dilatation and low thorium.
arms.non_fault_mimic: Primary rhyolite versus basalt lithologic contrast.
arms.uncatalogued_rationale: Potassic alteration can mark a fluid conduit that has no scarp.
arms.novelty: Not the RMRB mixing residual and not the CTHB K/Th cross-gradient.
arms.official_data: Pinned geodawn_rad_u8.tif is obtainable from the 60GEMSDOE GitHub mirror; not used in this 3-arm budget.

arms.transform: Updip projection of a dipping conductor from 2-6 km to the surface.
arms.non_fault_mimic: Flat playa brine and inversion smoothing.
arms.uncatalogued_rationale: A dipping clay cap can mark a blind fault whose surface trace is offset from the deep conductor.
arms.novelty: training_features.tif has one conductivity band, not depth slices. Prior prose that claimed six MT slices inside that TIFF is not used.
arms.official_data: ScienceBase raster not mirrored and not fetched. Not viable until that official grid is hash-pinned inside the sandbox.
